create_gtn_graph: create a gtn Graph object with a boolean flag to configure weighted or unweighted graph
add_node_to_graph: add a node to the graph with optional start and final state boolean flags
add_arc_to_graph: add an arc between two nodes in the graph with a symbol label integer
draw_graph_to_pdf: draw a gtn graph and export it to a PDF file with symbol label mappings
union_graphs: union multiple gtn graphs into a single combined graph using gtn.union
